text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
They're moving down the backstretch at an easy pace.
Could this development slightly favor the front-runners...?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? One of them is going for a long spurt here!
Little Cocon is already making her move!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Sprinting before the 3rd corner?!
Will she be okay...?!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Normally, it would be hard to say everything's fine.
However, Little Cocon is an exception.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is about to witness it firsthand.
—That girl's greatest weapon.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The other Umamusume make their move all at once!
However, Little Cocon's pace isn't dropping!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Little Cocon! Phenomenal tenacity!
A brilliant victory on this graded stakes stage!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Come forth.
......Some kind of amazing magic.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Think again! Take this!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, seriously. Can't we play something a bit more sensible...?
Wait, that's cold!? Why you...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day, Trainer Kiryuin invited us to hold a "get-together" inside the simulator.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The trainee under Trainer <username>
couldn't make time, huh?
...Well, it was an invitation on short notice, after all.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: It might have been pure luck that both the Three Goddesses and Trainer Kashimoto were available at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
We've settled things now that the spring races are over.
It was good timing for a breather.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Bitter Glasse did remarkably well
to make her presence felt in the Classic campaign.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon delivered solid results too.
Proof that her adjustments are going well!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek is also making steady progress
at her own pace.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, we've gradually started to see
some real growth!"

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
It's the fruit of you keeping a watchful eye on her.
That's why she can hold her pace with peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
How about you two?
Are things going well with <chrname>-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: How is <chrname> doing—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Fufu, please keep watching over them just like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks in part to the support of the Three Goddesses, each of the trainers is feeling a strong sense of progress.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, seeing Happy Meek and Bitter Glace
frolicking around happily gave a strong sense
of just how fulfilling it was for them."

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: You're growing steadily as a Trainer. Would calling you 'little lamb' be rude by now?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Stand tall! Even from where we're standing,
you've really grown as a Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
I pray these hoofprints leave a brilliant mark.
So that one day, they will become a legacy widely spoken of, and a pillar of support for many.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: The knowledge we impart to you all is, every bit of it, part of a grand history.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
In a sense, you run in the present by inheriting
the hoofprints left behind by past Umamusume and Trainers.
choice_data_list: The hoofprints of Umamusume and Trainers...

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Just as history shows, there is always
a Trainer standing beside an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: As one who runs alongside Umamusume, continue to devote yourself diligently from now on.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, time to go hang out with Little Cocon and the others!
To judge a Trainer's skill, looking at their Umamusume is best!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
Byerley Turk-san is way too fast!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Make better use of your own strengths!
Or you'll fall victim to my water gun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout the history of Umamusume,
a Trainer has always stood by their side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a relaxing break that made me feel there must be an indispensable, vital role to play.
